display_name: The Six Hundred and Seventy Martyrs

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 25 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Εξακόσιοι Εβδομήκοντα Mάρτυρες», with the rank word left off. The page names none of them. The Latin M the page prints at the head of «Mάρτυρες» is its own.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 25ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Εξακόσιοι Εβδομήκοντα Mάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/1054/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The company is not enumerated — the page names not one of them — so it is one folder, and nothing in the corpus answers to this number. `sex` is recorded as unknown: the couplet speaks of ἄνδρες, men, and the day's line does not, and the corpus's own pattern for an unenumerated company of a round number, `seventy-soldiers`, does the same. No year, no place, no emperor, no hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
